name: Local Recommendations
overview: Privacy-first personalized recommendations based on local watch history
description: Generate per-user content recommendations using TF-IDF embeddings and cosine similarity. All processing happens locally with zero tracking or cloud dependencies. Recommendations appear as virtual libraries accessible from all Jellyfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Faster server startup
- The startup play-status sync now runs in the background instead of blocking Jellyfin's 'Initializing server' phase (took several seconds per user)
- The sync stops early if the server shuts down

Jellyfin 12 support (fork of rdpharr/jellyfin-plugin-localrecs)
- Targets Jellyfin 12.4 / .NET 10
- No functional changes compared to 0.6.1
- REQUIRES Jellyfin 12.4 or newer
